manufacturing-quality-control.title: Smart Quality Control for Manufacturing
manufacturing-quality-control.desc: AI vision system developed for a large manufacturer to replace manual inspection.
manufacturing-quality-control.full_desc: Computer vision-based intelligent quality inspection system developed for a large manufacturing enterprise, replacing traditional manual inspection and improving detection accuracy and efficiency.

manufacturing-quality-control.solution: Deep learning-based CV solution, multi-station auto image acquisition, edge real-time inference, millisecond response.

smart-retail-recommendation.challenge: Large online traffic but low conversion, manual recommendation cannot achieve individual personalization.

predictive-maintenance-wind-farm.desc: Real-time monitoring of turbine status via sensors to predict potential failures.
predictive-maintenance-wind-farm.full_desc: Real-time monitoring of wind turbine status through sensor data, predicting potential failures and optimizing maintenance costs through AI scheduling.
predictive-maintenance-wind-farm.challenge: Remote wind turbines have high repair costs after failure, and unplanned downtime causes huge losses.
predictive-maintenance-wind-farm.solution: IIoT sensors for vibration, temperature, and acoustics, using time-series models to predict failures 7-14 days ahead.

intro.title: Introduction
intro.content: WSAI ("we", "our", or "us") respects your privacy and is committed to protecting your personal data. This privacy policy informs you how we look after your personal data when you visit our website and tells you about your privacy rights and how the law protects you.

collection.content: We may collect, use, store and transfer different kinds of personal data about you, including:

items.personal: Identity data: Name, username or similar identifier.
items.usage: Usage data: Information about how you use our website, products and services.
items.device: Technical data: IP address, browser type and version, time zone setting, operating system and platform.
items.cookies: Marketing and communications data: Your preferences in receiving marketing from us.

usage.title: How We Use Your Data
usage.content: We use your data only for purposeful business operations:

items.services: To provide and manage our AI solutions and services.
items.communication: To communicate regarding inquiries or support.
items.improvement: To improve our website functionality and user experience.
items.analytics: To analyze usage patterns for business optimization.

cookies.title: Cookies and Tracking
cookies.content: We use cookies and similar tracking technologies to track the activity on our service and hold certain information.

items.essential: Essential cookies: Required for the website to function properly.
items.analytics: Analytics cookies: To understand visitor behavior.
items.advertising: Advertising cookies: To deliver relevant advertisements and measure effectiveness.

cookies.manage: You can instruct your browser to refuse all cookies or to indicate when a cookie is being sent.

Pricing.title: Pencil Pen Importer
Pricing.subtitle: Seamlessly import .pen design files into Figma. Preserve layers, styles, and layouts with pixel-perfect accuracy.

features.title: Why Pencil Pen Importer?
features.subtitle: Bridge the gap between Pencil and Figma with a powerful, reliable import tool.

import.title: One-Click Import
import.desc: Import .pen files directly into Figma with a single click. No manual recreation needed.

styles.title: Style Preservation
styles.desc: Colors, gradients, typography, and effects are accurately mapped to Figma equivalents.

layout.title: Layout Fidelity
layout.desc: Auto-layout, constraints, and component hierarchy are maintained during import.

plans.title: Simple, Transparent Pricing
plans.subtitle: Choose the plan that fits your workflow. Start free, upgrade when you need more.

free.name: Starter
free.desc: Perfect for trying out the plugin and small projects.

features.f1: Import up to 5 files per month

pro.name: Pro
pro.desc: For professionals and teams who need unlimited power.

q1.a: .pen is the native file format used by Pencil, a modern UI design tool. The Pencil Pen Importer allows you to bring these designs into Figma without losing any detail.

q2.q: Can I cancel my subscription at any time?
q2.a: Yes. You can cancel your Pro subscription at any time. You'll continue to have access until the end of your current billing period. See our Refund Policy for details.

q3.a: The Starter plan includes 5 file imports per month with basic style preservation. For unlimited imports and advanced features, consider upgrading to Pro.

q4.q: How do I install the plugin?
q4.a: Click the 'Install Free on Figma' button to visit the Figma Community page. From there, click 'Try it out' to add the plugin to your Figma workspace.

intro.title: Overview
intro.content: At WSAI, we strive to ensure your satisfaction with our products and services. This Refund Policy outlines how refunds are handled for digital products purchased through our platform, including subscriptions to the Pencil Pen Importer Figma plugin.

nonRefundable.title: Non-Refundable Items

process.content: To request a refund, please follow these steps:

steps.step2: Our team will review your request within 3 business days and may ask for additional information.
steps.step3: If approved, the refund will be processed to your original payment method.

timeline.content: Once approved, refunds are typically processed within 5–10 business days. The exact timing depends on your payment provider. You will receive email confirmation once the refund has been issued.
